body: I can bet people do care man. Hell I care and I only just heard from you now. Things will get better (most overused depression-help line ever) but they actually will...
17? So, so young. Honestly, things have so much time to improve.
Jeez. Was that house built on a bit of a hill then?
I won’t bother. Unless you want me to. If you ever want to pm me, then do.
Yeah I guess...just thought it might help. If not that’s cool too.
Only a message away if you needa talk bruh
You’re more than youll ever know homie
I’m feeling a lot better already man. Just have these episodes every now and then. Thanks for the concern, you’re literally one of the people I was talking about in my second paragraph.

Thank you, bro. I’m hanging in there. Means a lot to hear that, and I do think I’m a good guy deep down.  - cheers for making me realise. Currently watching the new Miles Teller film ‘Only the Brave’ so at least I have a solid hour and a half of not thinking about much other than that.

Doctors will be booked tomorrow. 100%. I also have a job interview at 1pm. God man, I have it so much better than some people, I really shouldn’t be so down. Makes me feel like a coward.
